name: complaint-bot
description: A chatbot that collects hostel complaints, classifies them with an LLM and saves them to a CSV file.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.lint:server: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check . && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:client: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix client run typecheck
